1.10 Within-job convergence — starts in best job

Each job runs 5 starting points (3 structured: warm start, ×1.5, ×0.67; plus 2 random perturbations). Nelder-Mead runs independently from each start and the lowest-SSE start is selected as that job’s result.

Starting points within best job (job 2). NM evals = objective function calls used.

Note:
Starts 1-3: structured (warm start, x1.5, x0.67 perturbations). Starts 4-5: random perturbations. Max iterations reached (code 1) is normal behaviour for Nelder-Mead.
